signal: Ridgeline, the investment-management industry cloud founded by Workday and PeopleSoft co-founder Dave Duffield, crossed ~$104M ARR and keeps expanding across four US offices and 400+ employees.

email.body1:
Jesse, saw Ridgeline scale past $100M ARR while expanding across four offices.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market investment-management accounts in play than sales can personally cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Ridgeline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jesse, quick follow-up for Ridgeline.

At this stage of growth, the question is how many meetings the team needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of the number, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ridgeline needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Jesse, last bit of proof for Ridgeline.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ridgeline's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jesse, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters during fast expansion, and I know growing across that many offices is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Ridgeline either way.
